_about: Mock data for a small online shop ('Kala Leather Co.'). In real life this would come from Shopify/WooCommerce, the courier's API and the shop inbox. Carrier delivery records here are SIMULATED because sandbox tracking numbers have no real deliveries. Dates are written as {paid+N}: N days after the PayPal payment date, so the story always fits the real transaction (capped at today).
